We’re looking for a software engineer who fully embraces AI as a core part of
how they function and build software.
This is a hands-on role, focused on developing and evolving a modern SaaS
platform. You’ll take ownership across architecture, delivery, and product
JD example

12


collaboration, using AI to accelerate development, improve systems, and unlock
new capabilities.
You’ll work across the stack, connect data and systems, and continuously
improve how things are done, both in the product and how the team operates.
You may have worked in a bigger team and are looking for the opportunity and
flexibility to showcase your talent. We’re a small, collaborative team, and in this
role you'll have a big impact. We work closely together, share ideas openly, and
work to move quickly and build well, supporting and growing clients across
New Zealand, Australia, USA, and Canada.

What You’ll Do
Build and evolve the core platform with a focus on quality, scalability, and
speed
Use AI tools as a core part of your development workflow (coding, testing,
debugging, documentation)
Design and build integrations across systems (APIs, data sources, thirdparty platforms)
Enable data to flow through the product as insights, actions, and
engagement loops
Identify opportunities to automate workflows and reduce manual effort
Continuously improve how software is built through better tools, processes,
and AI usage

What We’re Looking For
Someone with a curiosity mindset and focus on getting things done
Strong software engineering fundamentals (full-stack or backend) with
experience in Java and AWS hosted solutions
Actively uses AI in their development workflow and is excited to go deeper
Experience working with APIs, integrations, and multiple data sources
Comfort working across systems and solving practical, real-world problems
Ability to take ownership while also collaborating closely with others

JD example

13


Mindset & Approach
AI engaged - you naturally reach for AI to improve how you work
Curious and exploratory - you enjoy testing ideas and discovering better
ways
Practical problem solver - you focus on real outcomes, not just theory
Collaborative - you bring your ideas and expertise to the team

Why This Role
You’ll work on solving problems that have a real impact on the users
You’ll have the freedom to bring your experience and curiosity as well as
apply AI in ways that change how things are done
You’ll be big part of a small, supportive team that works closely together
You’ll help shape both the product and how the team operates over time

About You
You’re an experienced software engineer who likes building systems and
features that users love. You understand APIs, integrations, and data, and how
to make them work well together.
You’re already using AI in your day-to-day work and constantly pushing it
further. You look for smarter, faster ways to build, automate, and improve things
around you.
You’re curious by default. When something feels manual or inefficient, you help
fix it.
You’re motivated by building technology that genuinely makes a difference to
its users and want to join us on our mission to empower companies to capture,
manage, and amplify their reputation in an increasingly digital world.
You’re comfortable taking ownership, but you also value being part of a team
that works closely and moves quickly.
You’ve worked with data and insights before, and if you’re familiar with surveys,
customer feedback, or review data, even better (but not essential).
Above all, you want to build things that have real impact on the users.
